details: A recent Reuters poll indicates the Bank of England (BoE) is likely to keep its Bank Rate at 3.75% throughout 2026 and into mid-2027. This decision comes despite elevated energy prices stemming from the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, as economists believe inflation is not yet strong enough to warrant further rate hikes. However, financial markets are currently pricing in three rate increases by mid-2027. Globally, bond yields have seen a sharp rise, contributing to tighter financial conditions.
title: Bank of England Expected to Maintain Rates Amidst War-Driven Inflation Risks

details: Economists polled by Reuters predict the European Central Bank (ECB) will raise interest rates by 25 basis points on September 10, bringing the deposit rate to 2.50%. This is expected to be the second and final hike in the current tightening cycle. The consensus suggests that rising energy prices are unlikely to trigger broad inflationary pressures, and the ECB is hesitant to impose further strain on a fragile economy. Inflation is not anticipated to return to the ECB's 2% target until late 2027.
title: ECB Set for Second, Final Rate Hike in September, Economists Say

details: A recent report from the New York Federal Reserve indicates that U.S. consumers' inflation expectations remained largely stable in August. However, concerns regarding the job market and personal financial well-being intensified, with unemployment rate expectations reaching their highest level since April 2020. Federal Reserve officials are currently divided on the necessity of further interest rate hikes, making the upcoming August Consumer Price Index (CPI) report on September 11 a critical data point for their policy meeting on September 15-16.
title: US Consumer Worries Rise on Jobs, Finances; Fed Rate Path Uncertain

details: Following a stronger-than-expected August U.S. jobs report, UBS Global Wealth Management has revised its forecast, now anticipating two 25-basis-point interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve this year, one in September and another in December. This represents a change from their previous expectation of no further policy adjustments. Financial markets are currently assigning a roughly 58% probability to a September rate increase.
title: UBS Projects Two Fed Rate Hikes in 2026 After Strong Jobs Data

details: Global markets are experiencing a mix of influences, with Brent crude oil approaching $100 a barrel due to ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. This is exacerbating inflation risks. Concurrently, the Japanese Yen has seen significant strengthening amid expectations of an imminent Bank of Japan rate hike. Despite these pressures, the global economic outlook remains robust, evidenced by a surge in China's August exports and an upward revision of the Eurozone's GDP. Copper prices have also hit an all-time high, indicating strong industrial demand.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Fuel Oil Surge, Yen Strength Amid Robust Global Growth
